shorelines_wetlands.label: Shorelines & Wetlands
shorelines_wetlands.definition: A shoreline, tidal flat, wetland or shallow channel organizes the routes and terrain.

rock_ice_caverns.label: Rock, Ice & Caverns
rock_ice_caverns.definition: Rock strata, ice, geological cavities, fossils or natural material flows organize the layout.

living_landscapes.label: Living Landscapes
living_landscapes.definition: Roots, fungi, other living forms or distinctly organism-shaped landforms build the traversable scene.

ruins_monuments.label: Ruins & Monuments
ruins_monuments.definition: Weathered architecture, abandoned infrastructure, or monumental stonework provides the major routes and landmarks.

works_yards.label: Works & Yards
works_yards.definition: Machinery, handling routes and work areas for production, extraction, servicing or repair organize the scene.

neighbourhoods_commons.label: Neighbourhoods & Commons
neighbourhoods_commons.definition: An everyday shared place is laid out around public circulation, gathering, care, culture, housing or neighbourhood services.

outposts_traces.label: Outposts & Traces
outposts_traces.definition: Sparse terrain and small, isolated installations or unmistakable human traces define the composition. Surviving traces may be historic.

technical_interiors.label: Technical Interiors
technical_interiors.definition: Installed equipment, service rooms and enclosed routes organize a laboratory, archive, base or other technical complex. An open-sided cutaway can qualify.

spacecraft_orbital_structures.label: Spacecraft & Orbital Structures
spacecraft_orbital_structures.definition: An identifiable spacecraft dominates the scene, or an orbital structure and its exposed vacuum routes give the scene its layout.

review_rule: Select the feature that organizes the routes and major landmarks. Keep style, material and secondary features in tags.
